command: A fixed rear three-quarter GTA San Andreas gameplay view. The maroon woman grips the driver by his bare forearm below the sleeve and pulls him sideways out of the open driver doorway. His fitted grey shirt stays against his torso as his arm moves freely. She releases his forearm as his hips leave the seat; he stumbles sideways and rolls once onto the pavement, then sits upright unharmed. She remains standing on both feet beside the open door and watches him clear the car. End with her standing still and the driver outside, before she enters. The blue taxi body and front-hinged door keep the same solid shape.

A calm fixed-camera GTA San Andreas interior cutscene. The navy physiotherapist gently presses her flat upper palm DOWN AND TOWARD SCREEN LEFT on top of the maroon woman's raised upper arm. Her other hand stabilises the right side of the waist. The seated woman exhales and lowers her ribs, head and overhead fingertips down-left into a slightly deeper side bend. Her supporting elbow bends softly, both hips and crossed legs stay planted on the mat. The therapist follows the downward movement, softly straightening her upper elbow while maintaining the same palm contact. They hold the deeper position peacefully for the final two seconds.

Fixed rear three-quarter gameplay camera. The maroon woman steps back and pulls the driver SIDEWAYS away from the taxi by his bare forearm. His whole body moves out through the open doorway, both feet land on the ROAD to the right, then he stumbles and rolls onto his hip, sitting upright on the road. She releases his bare forearm as soon as he is clear and stays standing in the same position outside the open door. The driver ends fully outside and visible to her right. His fitted grey polo remains close against his torso as his elbow bends, keeping its normal shape. Same solid blue taxi and open front-hinged door throughout.

Original 2004 GTA San Andreas PS2 low-polygon gameplay. Angular geometry, stable simple textures, pale teal sky and green foliage, consistent daytime lighting. One uninterrupted stationary rear three-quarter gameplay camera. Woman in maroon stays standing on BOTH FEET at all times until she sits in car. His close-fitting grey polo stays against his torso with a crisp sleeve hem. Her hand contacts only bare skin, away from the sleeve. She pulls grey-shirt driver SIDEWAYS out by his BARE FOREARM below the sleeve, stepping back once but keeping torso upright. Driver alone stumbles and rolls onto pavement to the right, conscious and unhurt. She releases him, immediately pivots toward open right driver doorway, bends at hips, puts her left leg inside, sits down in empty driver seat, swings her right leg inside and pulls door closed. The driver stays visible seated on road away from door. One woman, one driver, rigid opaque taxi body throughout. DO NOT make woman fall or tumble or vanish. Her movement is upright pull, pivot, step in, sit. Correct front-hinged door. No blood, no morphing, no cuts.
